speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: You are early, and you are leaving. The loaf is a penny. I am not cutting it to match a man who will not sit the meal.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: A crust, then. I am back at the Theatre by noon. There is a call, and I would rather take it where the tailor is not in this hall.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: I will not keep a dinner for a man who has already decided on a crust. The clove is still the one in the house. Do not ask me to shop between now and noon.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I am not asking. The jaw is hot enough to notice and not hot enough to spend the afternoon on. Egeon can have the side that works.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Then take the crust and go. If the call is about money, it can be about money up the road. This board had its price on Monday.
